content.short: Messari is a crypto market intelligence product suite.
content.description: Messari provides crypto market intelligence products to help professionals navigate crypto and Web3 with confidence. Its Messari Pro offering delivers advanced research and analytics tools for professional investors and Web3 enthusiasts. Messari supplies highly accurate, up-to-date information about the Web3 industry, supporting users as they evaluate markets, projects, and trends. The company is backed by prominent investors and venture firms in the industry.
